topIssues.title: kona: orphaned sources/variant.rs in kona-derive references non-existent AsyncIterator and stale API
topIssues.author: ajsutton
topIssues.body:
## Summary

`rust/kona/crates/protocol/derive/src/sources/variant.rs` exists in the kona-derive sources directory but is **not included in `sources/mod.rs`** and is therefore dead code. The file references:

- A non-existent `AsyncIterator` trait (not defined anywhere in the kona codebase)
- An outdated `CalldataSource::new(chain, block_ref, batcher_address)` 4-argument API that no longer matches the current 2-argument API

The file appears to be a leftover from the workspace migration (commit `48a7a09b`). It will fail to compile if added to the module tree. There is no runtime impact, but the file is misleading to developers browsing the source.

## Location

[`rust/kona/crates/protocol/derive/src/sources/variant.rs`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/a8a2956e695f18f53309ff0c30587a2a42961329/rust/kona/crates/protocol/derive/src/sources/variant.rs)

## Fix

Delete the file, or if there is a plan to restore it, update it to compile against the current API first.

## Context

Found during kona-node-vs-op-node conformance review (component: L1 Retrieval, finding LR-C05). Low priority — no runtime impact.

topIssues.title: kona: blob fetching failure leads to safe head stall
topIssues.author: joshklop
topIssues.body:
Looks like one of our kona nodes has a [safe head stall](https://optimistic.grafana.net/d/nUSlc3d4k/bedrock-networks?orgId=1&from=now-3h&to=now&timezone=browser&var-network=mainnet-dev&var-node=op-mainnet-kona-geth-a-rpc-1&var-layer=$__all&var-safety=$__all&var-cluster=$__all&var-konaNodes=$__all&refresh=30s). The logs say 

```
WARN blob_source: Failed to fetch blobs: error decoding response body
```

Dugtrigo is showing 404s. See logs from mainnet-l1-b [here](https://optimistic.grafana.net/a/grafana-lokiexplore-app/explore/namespace/mainnet-l1-b/logs?patterns=%5B%5D&from=2025-12-25T01:25:00.000Z&to=2025-12-25T01:59:59.000Z&var-lineFormat=&var-ds=grafanacloud-logs&var-filters=namespace%7C%3D%7Cmainnet-l1-b&var-filters=service_name%7C%3D%7Clighthouse&var-fields=&var-levels=detected_level%7C%3D%7Cunknown&var-metadata=&var-jsonFields=&var-patterns=&var-lineFilterV2=&var-lineFilters=&timezone=browser&var-all-fields=&displayedFields=%5B%5D&urlColumns=%5B%5D&visualizationType=%22logs%22&prettifyLogMessage=false&sortOrder=%22Descending%22&wrapLogMessage=false):

```
WARN Error processing HTTP API request elapsed_ms: 0.737062, status: 404 Not Found, path: /eth/v1/beacon/blobs/13316896, method: GET
```

The log appears even after the node has synced past slot 13316896, which was a [skipped slot](https://beaconscan.com/slot/13316896). Can kona handle skipped slots? (@geoknee also pointed out that this could be due to incomplete reorg handling, it the block in this slot was reorged out)

topPRs.title: chore(contracts-bedrock): bump Solidity version to 0.8.25
topPRs.author: smartcontracts
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Experimental PR to bump the Solidity compiler version in `packages/contracts-bedrock/` from 0.8.15 to 0.8.25.

- Updated 290 Solidity files across `src/`, `test/`, and `scripts/`
- Updated vendor EAS files from 0.8.19 to 0.8.25
- Updated `^0.8.15` floating pragmas to `^0.8.25`
- Left `^0.8.0`, `^0.8.8`, `^0.8.9`, `^0.8.13`, `^0.8.24`, and range pragmas unchanged (already compatible)
- Patch-bumped 54 contracts that showed bytecode changes
- Updated all hardcoded version expectations in validators and deploy scripts

## What Changed

| Category | Files | Details |
|----------|-------|---------|
| Pragma updates | 290 | `0.8.15` -> `0.8.25`, `0.8.19` -> `0.8.25`, `^0.8.15` -> `^0.8.25` |
| Version bumps | 54 | Patch bump all contracts with bytecode changes |
| Artifact disambiguation | 2 | `vm.getDeployedCode` path-qualified for `Proxy.sol` |
| Gas boundary tests | 1 | `SafeCall.t.sol` threshold adjustments |
| Hardcoded versions | 3 | `OPContractsManagerStandardValidator`, `DeploySaferSafes` script + test |
| Check scripts | 2 | `strict-pragma` test data, `semver-diff` exclusions |

## Decisions Made

1. **Vendor EAS files bumped to 0.8.25** -- Kept everything on a single compiler version to avoid artifact collisions.

2. **Left `^0.8.0` and other float pragmas alone** -- Libraries, interfaces, and utility files use floating pragmas that are already compatible.

3. **Path-qualified `vm.getDeployedCode` calls** -- With all contracts compiling under 0.8.25, some contracts sharing names with OpenZeppelin dependencies (e.g., `Proxy.sol`) produced ambiguous artifacts. Fixed by using path-qualified names.

4. **Updated gas boundary test constants** -- 0.8.25 generates slightly more efficient bytecode (PUSH0 opcode), reducing gas thresholds by 8-17 gas units in SafeCall tests.

5. **Excluded inheriting-version contracts from semver-diff** -- L1BlockCGT, L2StandardBridgeInterop, L2ToL1MessagePasserCGT use `string.concat(super.version(), suffix)` which the semver-diff check cannot parse. Added them to the exclusion list since parent versions are already validated.

6. **Updated OPContractsManagerStandardValidator** -- Hardcoded `preimageOracleVersion()` from 1.1.4 to 1.1.5 to match the bumped PreimageOracle.

## Complexity Report

**Moderate complexity, but highly mechanical.** Summary:

1. **Artifact name collisions** (key finding): When contracts-bedrock used 0.8.15 and OZ v5 used `^0.8.20`, Foundry compiled them with different compiler versions and could disambiguate artifacts. With both at 0.8.25, contracts with the same file name (e.g., `Proxy.sol`) collide. This is the most architecturally significant issue.

2. **54 version bumps needed** (mechanical): Every contract's bytecode changes with a new compiler, requiring patch bumps. This is the bulk of the diff.

3. **Gas boundary tests** (expected): Exact gas thresholds changed by 8-17 units.

4. **No breaking language changes**: Zero compilation errors despite 10 minor versions. `selfdestruct` deprecation already suppressed. No `block.difficulty` usage.

5. **Validator expectations**: The `OPContractsManagerStandardValidator` hardcodes expected contract versions, requiring updates when versions change.

## Side Effects

- **All 290 files** show pragma changes
- **54 contracts** have patch version bumps
- **semver-lock.json** regenerated (all bytecode hashes changed)
- Gas constants changed in SafeCall.t.sol
- `vm.getDeployedCode` paths changed in L2Genesis.s.sol and Predeploys.t.sol
- `check-semver-diff.sh` now excludes 3 inheriting-version contracts
- **No ABI changes** -- all changes are bytecode-only

## Test Results

- Build: passing (645 files compiled with single Solc 0.8.25)
- Tests: 2210 passed, 0 failed, 108 skipped
- `check-fast`: 17/17 checks passing

## Key Solidity changes available with 0.8.25

- 0.8.18: `block.prevrandao` (replaces `block.difficulty`)
- 0.8.20: Default EVM target changed to Shanghai (PUSH0 opcode)
- 0.8.22: Deprecation warnings for various features
- 0.8.24: Transient storage (`tstore`/`tload`), `mcopy`
- 0.8.25: Bug fixes and stability improvements

## Test plan

- [x] `just build-dev` passes (zero warnings)
- [x] `just test-dev` passes (2210/2210 tests, 108 skipped)
- [x] `just check-fast` passes (17/17 checks)
- [ ] CI checks (watching)

topPRs.title: fix(contracts-bedrock): remove artifact pulling, use unoptimized builds for CI tests
topPRs.author: mds1
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Removes the GCS-based artifact caching system from contracts CI and replaces it with simple unoptimized builds for PR test jobs. The caching system caused stale artifacts, profile mismatches, and non-deterministic artifact resolution (#19323).

**PR test jobs**: New `liteci` profile (`optimizer=false`, 128 fuzz runs). Compiles from scratch — no GCS pulls, no caching. Fast enough without optimizer.

**PR build/check jobs**: Still use `ci` profile (`optimizer=true`) for size-check, snapshots, interfaces, semver, kontrol, docker.

**Develop post-merge**: Test jobs use `ci` profile to mirror production bytecode.

### Fork test fix for unoptimized profiles

CREATE2 produces different implementation addresses with unoptimized bytecode. Most proxies are re-pointed during OPCM upgrade so their validator checks pass, but DelayedWETH and ETHLockbox proxies are NOT re-pointed — they retain mainnet's optimized implementations. Fixed by conditionally mocking `getProxyImplementation` for these proxies when running with an unoptimized profile.

### Unified `skipIfUnoptimized`

Renamed `skipIfCoverage` to `skipIfUnoptimized` and expanded it to also skip when the Foundry profile is unoptimized. Both coverage instrumentation and unoptimized builds change bytecode in ways that break gas measurement tests and bytecode verification tests.

### Removed

- `pull-artifacts.sh`, `publish-artifacts.sh`, `use-latest-fallback.sh`, `calculate-checksum.sh`
- `publish-contract-artifacts` job and `develop-publish-contract-artifacts` workflow
- `install-zstd` command, `pull-artifacts-conditional` command
- `publish_contract_artifacts_dispatch` pipeline parameter

### Profile summary

| Profile | Optimizer | Fuzz runs | Used where |
|---------|-----------|-----------|------------|
| `ci` | true, 999999 | 128 | Build job (all branches), test jobs (develop only) |
| `liteci` | false | 128 | Test jobs (PRs only) |
| `ciheavy` | false | 20000 | Heavy fuzz (PRs), nightly heavy fuzz |
| `cicoverage` | false | 1 | Coverage jobs |
| `lite` | false | 8 | Local dev (`just test-dev`) |

### Bonus fix

Fixed a TOML ordering bug in the `lite` profile where `additional_compiler_profiles` and `compilation_restrictions` were nested under `[profile.lite.invariant]` instead of `[profile.lite]`.

## Test plan

- [ ] CI passes (contracts tests compile from scratch with `liteci` profile)
- [ ] Build job still produces optimized artifacts for checks
- [ ] Develop post-merge runs tests with `ci` profile

topPRs.title: test(interop): add txpool eviction test for invalid exec msg on reorg
topPRs.author: karlfloersch
topPRs.body:
## Summary
- Adds integration tests verifying that interop transactions are evicted from the txpool during reorgs.
- Tests both the eviction path (with ingress filters enabled) and the no-filter path (without ingress filters) to confirm interop txs are only dropped when filtering is active.
- Includes shared test helpers and a mock interop filter.
- I've tested it with cycles up to 4 for the crash loop

This PR also includes a change to the op-node to fix a bug which was encountered during repeated crash looping. Description of the bug:
>The supernode has a deny list that persists block hashes across VN restarts. When a VN restarts after an invalidation, its derivation pipeline is fresh — it has no cached attributes (lastAttribs = nil). The pipeline derives the block, builds a payload, and the deny list recognizes the hash. It requests a "deposits-only" version of that block, but DepositsOnlyAttributes() needs the cached attributes from the previous derivation to strip out user txs. Since the pipeline just started, there are no cached attributes, so it throws a CriticalError and kills the VN. A new VN starts, hits the same deny list, same crash — infinite VN crash loop.

I **do not** feel confident in the fix (derivation error->derivation reset). Please help verify!

## Pre-requisites
- https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/772 (op-geth: txpool interop tx eviction on reorg)
  - Tests will fail until this is included.
